parts.label: Kilobyte
parts.prompt: How many bytes is 1 kilobyte on this sheet? A power of two is enough.

fields.label: bytes
fields.hint: One step of the binary group. Not 1000.

traps.hint: This sheet uses a power of two, not 1000.

parts.label: Megabyte
parts.prompt: How many bytes is 1 megabyte? Stack another binary group on the kilobyte.

fields.label: bytes
fields.hint: A megabyte stacks the binary group a second time.

traps.hint: That is one kilobyte. Mega stacks that group again.
This sheet uses powers of two, not powers of 10.

parts.label: Gigabyte
parts.prompt: How many bytes is 1 gigabyte? One more binary group.

fields.label: bytes
fields.hint: A gigabyte stacks the binary group a third time.

traps.hint: That is a megabyte. Giga stacks one more group.
This sheet uses powers of two, not powers of 10.
